# Barima Holdings

> Barima Holdings is the parent company of three businesses serving customers in Ghana, Canada and the United States: Barima Automobile & Transportation Services (vehicle sourcing and B-Drive private rides), Barima Homes (litigation-free land, houses and apartments in Ghana) and Barima Cuisine (Ghanaian food and catering).

Each company has its own website, team and contact line. The group's general email is barimaholdings@gmail.com.

## Companies

- [Barima Automobile & Transportation Services](https://automobile.barimaholdings.com/): Buys any make and model of vehicle for customers in Canada and Ghana and ships to Ghana (Ghana customers pay duty and clear the vehicle on arrival). Also runs B-Drive, private pick-up, drop-off, airport transfers and parcel deliveries across Ontario, Canada. Phone and WhatsApp +1 (416) 605-6280, barimaautomobile.ca@gmail.com (sourcing), bdrive.ca@gmail.com (B-Drive). Open Sunday to Friday, 8am to 5pm Eastern Time.
- [Barima Homes](https://homes.barimaholdings.com/): Sells litigation-free land, houses and apartments in Ghana. Phone and WhatsApp 054 858 0304 (+233 54 858 0304), also +1 416 605 6280, barimaholdings@gmail.com.
- [Barima Cuisine](https://barimacuisine.com/): Healthy Ghanaian food (jollof, waakye, fufu and more) and catering for weddings, parties and corporate events in Ghana, Canada and the United States. Ghana 054 858 0304, Canada 437 448 0433, info@barimacuisine.com.

## Where we operate

- Ghana: homes, cuisine, vehicle imports
- Canada: vehicle sourcing, B-Drive rides (Ontario), cuisine
- United States: cuisine
